notes.title: OMEXYAN Awaits You!
notes.notes:
Keep an eye on OMEXYAN!
If you're interested in the project and want to stay updated on new announcements, updates, or when the game becomes available, you can add it to your wishlist on Steam.

This way, you'll be sure not to miss anything![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45379955/f0206381c5e631aebf447b7167d2f0cc797bd33a.png[/img]
